analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced connection problems with the USB cable and [company_name] software on Mac OS 10.6.6. Contributors noted official support seems limited to Windows or older Mac versions, such as 10.4, and getting it to work on newer Mac versions like 10.6 presents challenges. Permission issues with VAR files were highlighted as a possible obstacle. Overall, users searched for solutions but faced unclear compatibility and frustrating workarounds.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hoped the USB connection with [company_name] software would work immediately and smoothly on Mac OS 10.6.6, without requiring extra configuration, workarounds, or adjustments to permissions.
